title: R41-C2 table v3 — feature-tuple test vectors with precedence-derived expected (label, action)
label_source: plans/round-41-claims.md **Label precedence** steps 1-12 (draft, lines 72-88 at base 49096c7e6f226af0c750c4b003be58883cb6049f, file uncommitted). Expected labels were derived ONLY from that text and re-checked mechanically by validate-vectors.py against a direct transcription of the 12 steps; no generator class map, no table and no interpreter was used to derive them.
action_source: The (label -> action) map fixed by the wave design (R41C2Eval item prompt; for the 11 labels shared with v2 it equals the frozen v2 table's action column, SKILL.md:363-375). The claims text does not state the map yet - see report finding F11.

feature_fields.PR: data.provider.id string (provider object form; '' when absent)
feature_fields.H: sorted set of chunk handler names as collected by the v2 features() rule (normalized_result.chunks[].handler startswith 'squashfs'). Report finding F1 recommends pinning the collection to startswith 'squashfs_v4_' in the claims text; under that amendment a vector whose H holds only non-v4 squashfs names is no longer representable (H becomes []).
feature_fields.G: sorted set of normalized_result.extraction_gaps[].kind; the REA 6.5.0 enum is closed: missing-extractor-dependency, unknown-chunk-handler, encrypted-chunk, depth-limited, extractor-failure, unpublished-entry (rea-agents dist/domain/firmware/firmwareAnalysis.js:79-99)
feature_fields.BE: 'yes' iff some recorded command whose basename starts with 'sasquatch' carries a standalone '-be' token; 'no' iff such a command is recorded and none carries '-be'; 'n/a' iff no such command is recorded (successful extractions record no command, so every clean/escaping/in-tree/mixed/dep tuple observed so far has BE=n/a)
feature_fields.SR: 'yes' iff a report with __typename__ 'MaliciousSymlinkRemoved' is recorded under normalized_result.diagnostics, data.diagnostics or anywhere in raw_result; else 'no'. An empty-target symlink removal is silent (no report).
feature_fields.P: len(normalized_result.files) - REA publishes only entries with kind === 'file', so this is exactly the published regular files (rea-agents dist/firmware/FirmwarePublication.js:57-88)

envelope_recipe: To realize a tuple as a synthetic envelope for an interpreter selftest: data = {operation: OP, provider: {id: PR}, normalized_result: {chunks: H.map(h => ({handler: h})), extraction_gaps: G.map(k => ({kind: k, dependencies: (k === 'missing-extractor-dependency' ? D : [])})), files: Array(P).fill({}), diagnostics: []}}; then for BE 'yes' push {report: {command: 'sasquatch-v4be -be -no-exit-code -f -d OUT IN'}} and for BE 'no' the same command without '-be' into normalized_result.diagnostics; for SR 'yes' push {report: {__typename__: 'MaliciousSymlinkRemoved'}}. This mirrors tools/round-40/sqfs-triage-v2.py features() (lines 516-597). Escape hatch for G44 only: features() reads gap.kind and gap.dependencies independently, so a kindless gap {'dependencies': ['sasquatch']} with no 'kind' key realizes G=[] with D nonempty; REA never mints such a gap (unreachable-by-construction).

resolutions.step-2-glob: Step 2 is read literally: the condition is 'no member of H matches the glob squashfs_v4_*'. Under the draft grammar (handler cell forms *, none, pattern only) this is encodable only as handler `none` (H = []), which diverges for H holding non-v4 squashfs names (vector G07). Report finding F1 recommends pinning H's membership to squashfs_v4_* handlers in the claims features sentence, which makes step 2 equivalent to H = [] and the divergence disappear.
resolutions.step-3-both-named: When D contains both sasquatch-v4be and sasquatch the precedence text names both branches; the vectors use the first-listed branch (dep-missing-be), which is also what a be-row-first first-match table produces once the dependencies cell supports membership (finding F2). 'names' is exact element equality, never a prefix test ('sasquatch' is a prefix of 'sasquatch-v4be').
resolutions.step-3-neither-named: When missing-extractor-dependency is in G but D names neither executable, the step's condition is true and neither branch matches; the vectors use fall-through to step 4 (the natural first-match reading: the two dep rows' deps cells simply do not match). The claims text should state this (finding F2).
